sections.heading: Loot Table
sections.text:
- All rewards except for currency can be obtained just once. Every time you receive a common rarity reward, the chance of receiving higher rarity rewards increases:
  - Rare by 0.67%
  - Super Rare by 0.4%
  - Epic by 0.2%
  - Legendary by 0.12%
- Upon receiving a higher rarity reward, the chance of that rarity resets.
